text_ar_search:
وعنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم  قال: 
"يصلون لكم، فإن أصابوا فلكم، وإن أخطؤوا فلكم وعليهم" ((رواه البخاري)).
text_en: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Your leaders will lead you in Salat (prayer). If they conduct it properly, you and they will be rewarded; but if they make mistakes you will earn the reward and they will be held responsible (for the mistakes).".
